title: Submit a YouTube video for live analysis
description: This verifies that an authenticated user can submit a YouTube URL in the dashboard and receive a completed analysis with the expected report outputs.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill in {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Navigate to /dashboard
Paste a valid YouTube URL into the video URL field
Submit the analysis request
Verify completed analysis results are displayed
Verify the executive digest and entity exploration outputs are displayed

title: Sign in and reach the dashboard
description: A visitor can complete sign-in and land in the authenticated dashboard ready to start analysis.

steps.description: Navigate to /auth/signin
Click the sign-in with Google control
Complete authentication with valid credentials
Verify the user lands on the dashboard

title: Start a grounded chat from a completed analysis
description: This verifies that a user can ask a question in chat after analysis completion and receive a grounded reply based on the video content.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill in {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Navigate to /dashboard
Paste a valid YouTube URL into the video URL field
Submit the analysis request
Open the chat panel
Type a question about the analyzed video into the chat field
Send the chat message
Verify a grounded chat reply is displayed
Verify the conversation history includes the new question

title: Reuse a previously analyzed video from cache
description: This verifies that submitting a previously analyzed YouTube URL returns an existing completed analysis without blocking the user from reviewing results.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill in {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Navigate to /dashboard
Paste a previously analyzed valid YouTube URL into the video URL field
Submit the analysis request
Verify completed analysis results are displayed
Verify the existing analysis output is returned for review

title: Search saved analyses and reopen a result
description: A member can find a previously generated analysis in saved history and reopen it from the result list.

steps.description: Navigate to /analyses/saved
Review the saved analysis list
Search analyses by keyword
Open a matching analysis to revisit the results
Verify the analysis results are displayed

Complete the checkout flow
Verify the subscription state is updated
